Compute the measures of the shaded angles in the figure above.
question.worked_solution:
The two angles marked in the diagram are vertical. Since vertical angles are congruent, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}8w-{24}^{∘} & =6w-{6}^{∘} \\ 2w-{24}^{∘} & =-{6}^{∘} \\ 2w & ={18}^{∘} \\ w & ={9}^{∘}\end{aligned}
$$

Now that we know $w={9}^{∘},$ we can substitute into one of the expressions to calculate the measure of the angles. Let's substitute into the expression $6w-{6}^{∘}:$

$$
6({9}^{∘})-{6}^{∘}={48}^{∘}.
$$

Therefore, both angles have a measure of ${48}^{∘}.$
